whatIsSection.title: Why Choose Dubai Silicon Oasis Free Zone?
paragraphs: Dubai Silicon Oasis Free Zone (DSO) is an award-winning innovation district, created for startups, tech companies, and advanced manufacturers.

It blends a prime Dubai location with smart city living — providing business owners a uniquely designed platform from which to innovate, interact, and grow. Access to talent, solid legal frameworks, advanced smart infrastructure, and friendlier regulations make DSO a platform that allows businesses to future-proof themselves.

items.q: What is Dubai Silicon Oasis Free Zone and who should set up here?
items.a: DSO is a government-backed innovation park and free zone designed for tech-enabled businesses, startups, and advanced manufacturing. Ideal for AI, software, robotics, e-commerce, fintech, and IoT companies.

items.q: What licenses are available in DSO?
items.a: Trade License (buying/selling goods), Service License (consultancies, software, media), Industrial License (manufacturing), and E-commerce License (online stores).

items.q: Can a freelancer register a company in DSO?
items.a: Yes. DSO offers freelancer permits and cost-effective packages for individual professionals.

items.q: What is the time frame to set up a DSO company?
items.a: Typically 3-5 business days depending on documentation and license type.
Passport copies, digital photos, application form, business plan (for some activities), and NOC if applicable.

items.q: Can I apply for visas under my DSO company?
items.a: Yes. DSO allows visa quotas based on office type and size — investor, employee, and dependent visas.

items.q: What kinds of offices are available?
items.a: Co-working spaces, executive suites, private offices, innovation labs, logistics hubs, and data centers.
Starting from approximately AED 15,500 depending on activity, structure, and package. Contact us for a custom quote.
